en.headline: Police officer left paralysed in 2005 knife attack dies after 21 years
en.dek: Constable Chu Chun-kwok, awarded the Medal for Bravery (Gold) for chasing an armed attacker despite a severed artery, died on Wednesday at the age of 52.
body: A Hong Kong police constable who spent 21 years paralysed after a knife attack while on duty has died, local reports confirmed on Thursday.
Chu Chun-kwok, also known as Jacky Chu, died on Wednesday at Kwong Wah Hospital at the age of 52. He had been left quadriplegic and unable to speak after the assault on 19 July 2005.

That morning, Chu, then about 30 and on solo patrol outside the Po On Road Municipal Services Building in Cheung Sha Wan, stopped a suspicious 23-year-old man for a check. The man, Liu Chi-yung, suddenly drew a fruit knife and slashed Chu’s left neck, severing an artery. Despite heavy bleeding, Chu chased the attacker for about 50 metres before collapsing from blood loss and brain hypoxia.

Liu discarded the knife and later surrendered at Prince Edward MTR station the same afternoon. He was sentenced to 10 years’ imprisonment after an appeal raised an initial six-year term. He was released on parole after serving about five years and nine months.

In 2006 the government awarded Chu the Medal for Bravery (Gold). The citation praised his exceptional courage in continuing the pursuit of an armed assailant while bleeding heavily. Police compensation and subsidies paid to him in the years after the attack exceeded HK$4.94 million, according to court documents from 2011.

The Junior Police Officers’ Association chairman said on Thursday that the force’s management supported burial in Gallant Garden and suggested a funeral with police honours. Chu’s wife and daughter had cared for him throughout the years.

zh.headline: 2005年執勤被斬頸癱瘓21年 警員朱振國離世
zh.dek: 朱振國周三於廣華醫院逝世，終年52歲。他曾獲頒金英勇勳章，表揚在頸動脈被割斷下仍追截持刀兇徒。
body: 一名在2005年執勤期間遭持刀襲擊、其後癱瘓21年的前警員，周四據報已於周三離世。
朱振國（Jacky Chu）周三於廣華醫院逝世，終年52歲。他自2005年7月19日遇襲後一直四肢癱瘓，無法言語。
當日早上，時年約30歲的朱振國單獨在長沙灣保安道市政大廈外巡邏，截查一名可疑男子。該名當時23歲的男子劉志勇突然拔出水果刀，割向朱振國左邊頸部，割斷頸動脈。朱振國在大量失血下仍追截約50米，其後因失血及腦缺氧倒下。
劉志勇棄刀逃走，當日下午在太子港鐵站向另一名警員自首。他其後被判監，上訴後刑期由六年改為十年，約五年九個月後獲假釋。
2006年政府頒授金英勇勳章予朱振國，嘉許他在大量流血下仍追截持械兇徒的勇氣。根據2011年法庭文件，事發後數年警方已向他支付超過494萬元津貼及補償。
警察員佐級協會主席周四表示，警隊管理層支持將朱振國安葬於浩園，並建議以警察榮譽舉行葬禮。朱振國的妻子及女兒多年來一直照顧他。
